title: Priest in Peril
start: Speak to King Roald in the Varrock Palace.

items.t: 50 rune essence or 25 pure essence (the essence must be un-noted)

recommended.t: A familiar to carry any essence that you are unable to fit into your inventory.
The Archaeology journal gained after completing the Archaeology tutorial can teleport you relatively close to the temple, or alternatively using the Fort Forinthry lodestone if unlocked.
Invitation box to teleport near the temple (requires completion of Missing, Presumed Death).

rewards.t: Talk to Historian Minas at the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos

steps.t: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. [Chat: 2 Greet the king. › Accept] (if New Foundations is started. [Chat: 3 Greet the king. › Accept])
Go to the temple in Silvarea which is east of the earth altar.

sub.t: Players with an invitation box can teleport twice to arrive outside the temple.

steps.t: Knock at the large door of the temple. [Chat: 2 Knock at the door. › 1 Roald sent me to check on Drezel. › 1 Yes.]
Go north and enter the mausoleum.
Talk to King Roald. [Chat: 1 Talk about Priest in Peril.]
At this time you can bring the 25 unnoted pure essence to save a trip later.
Enter the Temple and kill a level 23 Monk of Zamorak to obtain a golden key.
Go outside and enter the Mausoleum to the north and through the gate.
Use the golden key on the one that has the iron key.
Fill a bucket with water from the well in the centre of the monument room.
Go back to the temple and climb to the top floor.
p: Killing one of the Zamorakian monks in the temple.

steps.t: Use the iron key on the cell door and talk to Drezel.
Use the bucket of blessed water on the Morytania coffin.
p: Pouring the blessed water on the coffin.

steps.t: Return to the mausoleum, enter the monument room, and speak with Drezel.
Talk to him again to give him 50 unnoted rune essence or 25 unnoted pure essence.
